author: Sivartisan
title: Wonderful but most recent redesign has serious flaws
content:
Been playing this chess app since 2020 and loving it, but the most recent redesign had serious flaws. 

First, in the game recap, the system interrupts the recap to give points toward some nebulous “skill” category, the benefits of which are what? Besides slowing down the recap to a crawl. 

Also, I’m getting move recommendations that seem very odd. Like, it’s saying the best move was to move the queen out of the way of an attack when moving one more square would have captured a free rook, but will not “show” its logic with subsequent moves. I screencapped this if the dev want to see. 

And last on my short list, in the puzzles section, a wrong move will cost 12 points while a solved puzzle will gain only 2 or 3 points. This feels wildly out of balance compared to how it used to be. A series of mistakes can cost you the progress of weeks worth of work, to the point where it discourages puzzle solving at all…

3/5 stars until latest iteration is smoothed out. Ditch the Generative AI, just go back to having the best chess app for real chess players, gang!

*one nice thing, I have really liked the fresh batches of themed bots to play over the years, the the newest level of that, where you can unlockp new boards and pieces is seriously fun and rewarding

There are many flaws, but one in particular is where the game will call a draw just before a checkmate even though the opponent has evaded checkmate for only 2 - 3 moves prior. This is a major flaw in the game. There should a standard that applies to all games.

The game also has a glitch where it will move the piece to a square adjacent to the one selected. And, no, this is not me just missing the square. I know this because you can hit the back arrow to see which square is highlighted (which one you selected), and it shows the correct square, but it’s not where the piece is moved to.

author: usuck 67
title: Broken Matchmaking and Hostile for OTB Players
content:
The matching algorithm on this app is completely broken for anyone who wants to play logical chess. I set my custom to strictly pair me with higher rated opponents (650+ Elo) to match my actual over-the-broad skill level. Instead, the app constantly overrides my settings, ignores my preferences, and dumps me into sub-500 matchups just to speed up pairings times.

When you try to manually avoid these chaotic, un-broken players by aborting the system punishes you by disabling the abort button and tanking your Elo down when you refuse to play them. To make matters worse, recent updates completely hid the Open Challenges lobby on mobile, removing any agency the player has. 

Fix your rating filters and stop forcing overrides. Until the app actually respects user settings and provides a function lobby I am taking my play to Lichess.org, where the interface is clean, features aren’t hidden, and ratings aren’t trapped by glitchy pools right after the league matches are over.
